sentences.text: This dinosaur lived during the Late Cretaceous in what is now China.
The preserved ilium shaft ends in a large boot shape pointing obliquely downwards and forwards in side view.
This bone measurement suggests a total body length of nearly 8 meters.
The species Zuoyunlong huangi was named and described in 2017 by a team led by Wang Runfu.
Cladistic analysis places Zuoyunlong in a basal position within Hadrosauroidea as the sister taxon of Probactrosaurus.
Zuoyunlong lived during the Cenomanian stage, between 101 and 95 million years ago.
